lines.en: This is Adam and this is Eve, who were the first people on earth.
lines.zh: 這是亞當，這是夏娃，他們是世上最早的人。

lines.en: They lived in the Garden of Eden, which was a beautiful place that had everything they needed.
lines.zh: 他們住在伊甸園，那是一個美麗的地方，凡他們所需要的都有。

lines.en: Adam and Eve took care of the animals and could eat from any of the trees in the garden except for one.
lines.zh: 亞當和夏娃照管動物，園中各樣樹上的果子他們都可以吃，只有一棵除外。

lines.en: This was the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, and God told them not to eat from this tree.
lines.zh: 那就是分別善惡的樹，神吩咐他們不可吃這棵樹的果子。

lines.en: There were lots of animals in the garden, but the serpent was the most clever of all the wild animals God had made.
lines.zh: 園中有許多動物，但在神所造的一切野獸中，蛇最狡猾。

lines.en: One day he asked the woman, "Did God really say you must not eat the fruit from any of these trees in the garden?"
lines.zh: 有一天，蛇問女人：「神豈是真說，不許你們吃園中所有樹上的果子嗎？」

lines.en: Eve said that they were able to eat from all of the fruit trees except the fruit from the tree in the middle of the garden.
lines.zh: 夏娃說，園中所有果樹的果子他們都可以吃，只有園子當中那棵樹的果子不行。

lines.en: "For God said, 'You must not eat or even touch it. If you do, you will die.'"
lines.zh: 「因為神曾說：『你們不可吃，也不可摸，免得你們死。』」

lines.en: "You won't die," said the serpent.
lines.zh: 蛇說：「你們不一定死。」

lines.en: "God knows that as soon as you eat it, you will be like God, knowing both good and evil."
lines.zh: 「因為神知道，你們吃的日子眼睛就明亮了，你們便如神能知道善惡。」

lines.en: The woman was convinced.
lines.zh: 女人被說服了。

lines.en: She saw that the tree was beautiful and its fruit looked delicious, and she wanted the wisdom it would give her.
lines.zh: 她見那棵樹很美，果子看起來好吃，又想得著它能帶來的智慧。

lines.en: So she took some of the fruit and ate it.
lines.zh: 她就摘下果子吃了。

lines.en: Then she gave some to Adam, and he ate it too.
lines.zh: 又給了亞當，他也吃了。

lines.en: At that moment their eyes were opened, and they suddenly realized they weren't wearing clothes and were embarrassed.
lines.zh: 那一刻他們的眼睛就明亮了，忽然發現自己沒穿衣服，覺得很羞愧。

lines.en: So they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.
lines.zh: 於是他們用無花果樹的葉子編成裙子遮身。

lines.en: When the cool evening breezes were blowing, Adam and Eve heard God walking about in the garden.
lines.zh: 傍晚涼風吹起時，亞當和夏娃聽見神在園中行走的聲音。

lines.en: So they hid from God among the trees.
lines.zh: 他們就藏在園裡的樹木中，躲避神。

lines.en: Then God called to Adam, "Where are you?"
lines.zh: 神呼喚亞當說：「你在哪裡？」

lines.en: Adam said, "I heard you walking in the garden, so I hid. I was afraid because I was naked."
lines.zh: 亞當說：「我在園中聽見你的聲音，我就藏了。我害怕，因為我赤身露體。」

lines.en: "Who told you that you were naked?" God asked.
lines.zh: 神問：「誰告訴你赤身露體呢？」

lines.en: "Did you eat from the tree I told you not to eat from?"
lines.zh: 「莫非你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那樹上的果子嗎？」

lines.en: Adam said, "It was the woman you gave me who gave me the fruit, and I ate it."
lines.zh: 亞當說：「你所賜給我、與我同居的女人，她把那樹上的果子給我，我就吃了。」

lines.en: Then God asked Eve, "What have you done?"
lines.zh: 神就問夏娃：「你做的是甚麼事呢？」

lines.en: "The serpent tricked me," she replied. "That's why I ate it."
lines.zh: 她回答：「那蛇引誘我，我就吃了。」

lines.en: Then God punished the serpent by making it so he would crawl on his belly from then on.
lines.zh: 神就懲罰那蛇，使牠從此用肚子行走。

lines.en: He told Eve that she would have great pain in her life.
lines.zh: 祂告訴夏娃，她一生將受許多苦楚。

lines.en: Then God said to Adam that because he listened to Eve and did not obey what God had told him to do, his life would be very difficult.
lines.zh: 神又對亞當說，因他聽了夏娃的話，沒有遵守神的吩咐，他的一生將十分艱難。

lines.en: He would have to work hard to get food to eat.
lines.zh: 他必須辛苦勞碌才得糊口。

lines.en: God said, "For you were made from dust, and to dust you will return."
lines.zh: 神說：「你本是塵土，仍要歸於塵土。」

lines.en: Then God made them clothing from the animals.
lines.zh: 神用動物的皮給他們做衣服。

lines.en: But God knew that Adam and Eve could no longer live in the garden because of their sin.
lines.zh: 但神知道，亞當和夏娃因為犯了罪，不能再住在園子裡。

lines.en: So he sent them away and closed up the garden.
lines.zh: 於是祂打發他們離開，把園子關閉了。

lines.en: Now at this time, Noah pleased God and was the only righteous man living on earth.
lines.zh: 那時，挪亞蒙神喜悅，是地上唯一的義人。

lines.en: He had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
lines.zh: 他有三個兒子：閃、含、雅弗。

lines.en: The earth had become corrupt and was filled with violence.
lines.zh: 世界敗壞了，地上滿了強暴。

lines.en: So God said to Noah, "I have decided to destroy all living creatures, for they have filled the earth with violence."
lines.zh: 神就對挪亞說：「我決定要毀滅一切活物，因為地上滿了他們的強暴。」

lines.en: "Yes, I will wipe them all out with the earth."
lines.zh: 「我要把他們和地一併毀滅。」

lines.en: He instructed Noah, "Build a large boat from cypress wood and waterproof it with tar inside and out."
lines.zh: 祂吩咐挪亞：「你要用歌斐木造一艘大船，裡外抹上松香（瀝青），使它不漏水。」

lines.en: "Then construct decks and stalls throughout its interior."
lines.zh: 「再在裡面建造甲板和一間一間的隔間。」

lines.en: "Make the boat 450 feet long, 75 feet wide, and 45 feet high."
lines.zh: 「船要長 450 呎、寬 75 呎、高 45 呎。」

lines.en: "Leave an 18-inch opening below the roof all the way around the boat."
lines.zh: 「在船頂下方四周留一道 18 吋的透光口。」

lines.en: "Put the door on the side, and build three decks inside the boat: lower, middle, and upper."
lines.zh: 「門要開在旁邊，船內要分上、中、下三層。」

lines.en: "Look," said the Lord, "I am about to cover the earth with a flood that will destroy every living thing that breathes."
lines.zh: 耶和華說：「看哪，我要使洪水氾濫在地上，毀滅一切有氣息的活物。」

lines.en: "But I will confirm my covenant with you."
lines.zh: 「我卻要與你立約。」

lines.en: "So enter the boat, you and your wife and your sons and their wives."
lines.zh: 「你同你的妻，與兒子兒婦，都要進入方舟。」

lines.en: "Bring a pair of every kind of animal, and be sure to take on board enough food for your family and for all the animals."
lines.zh: 「每一種動物都要帶一對，也要帶足夠的食物給你的家人和所有動物。」

lines.en: Noah obeyed God and built the ark precisely as God had instructed.
lines.zh: 挪亞順服神，完全照神的吩咐建造了方舟。

lines.en: The Lord said to Noah, "Go into the boat with all your family, for among all the people of the earth, I can see that you alone are good."
lines.zh: 耶和華對挪亞說：「你和你的全家都要進入方舟，因為在這世代中，我見你在我面前是義人。」

lines.en: "Take with you the animals I approve."
lines.zh: 「把我所認可的動物帶進去。」

lines.en: "Seven days from now I will make the rains pour down on the earth."
lines.zh: 「再過七天，我要降雨在地上。」

lines.en: "It will rain for forty days and forty nights, until I have wiped from the earth all the living things I have created."
lines.zh: 「四十晝夜，把我所造的各種活物都從地上除滅。」

lines.en: At this time, Noah was six hundred years old.
lines.zh: 那時挪亞六百歲。

lines.en: So Noah entered the boat with his wife and his sons and their wives.
lines.zh: 挪亞就同他的妻和兒子兒婦都進入方舟。

lines.en: Two by two, one pair of every kind of animal came into the boat, representing every living thing that breathes.
lines.zh: 各樣的動物一對一對地進入方舟，代表一切有氣息的活物。

lines.en: Then the Lord closed the door behind them.
lines.zh: 耶和華就把他們關在方舟裡。

lines.en: For forty days the flood waters grew deeper, covering the ground and lifting the boat high above the earth.
lines.zh: 洪水氾濫四十天，水勢越漲越深，淹沒地面，把方舟高高托起。

lines.en: The only people who survived were Noah and those with him in the boat.
lines.zh: 只留下挪亞和那些與他同在方舟裡的人。

lines.en: When the time came, God sent a wind and the rain stopped.
lines.zh: 時候到了，神叫風吹地，雨就止住了。

lines.en: Noah opened a window and released a raven.
lines.zh: 挪亞開了窗戶，放出一隻烏鴉。

lines.en: The bird flew back and forth until the flood waters on the earth had dried up.
lines.zh: 那烏鴉飛來飛去，直到地上的水都乾了。

lines.en: He also released a dove to see if it could find dry ground.
lines.zh: 他又放出一隻鴿子，要看看地上是否有乾地。

lines.en: Noah waited, and the dove returned.
lines.zh: 挪亞等候，鴿子回來了。

lines.en: He tried again, and the dove returned to him, this time with a fresh olive leaf in its beak.
lines.zh: 他再試一次，鴿子又回到他那裡，這次嘴裡叼著一片新擰下來的橄欖葉。

lines.en: Noah released the dove again. This time it did not come back.
lines.zh: 挪亞又放出鴿子，這次牠不再回來了。

lines.en: When the earth was dry, God said to Noah, "Leave the boat, all of you."
lines.zh: 地都乾了，神對挪亞說：「你們都出方舟吧。」

lines.en: "Release all the animals so they can be fruitful and multiply throughout the earth."
lines.zh: 「把所有動物都放出來，叫牠們在地上多多滋生，大大興旺。」

lines.en: So Noah, his family, and all the animals followed God's instructions and came out of the ark.
lines.zh: 於是挪亞、他的家人和所有動物都照神的吩咐出了方舟。

lines.en: Noah built an altar to worship the Lord, and this pleased the Lord.
lines.zh: 挪亞為耶和華築了一座壇敬拜祂，耶和華就喜悅。

lines.en: God blessed Noah and his sons and told them, "Be fruitful and multiply. Fill the earth."
lines.zh: 神賜福給挪亞和他的兒子，對他們說：「你們要生養眾多，遍滿了地。」

lines.en: Then God said, "I hereby confirm my covenant with you. Never again will a flood destroy the earth."
lines.zh: 神說：「我與你們立約，凡有血肉的，不再被洪水滅絕，也不再有洪水毀壞地了。」

lines.en: "I am giving you a sign of my covenant by placing my rainbow in the clouds."
lines.zh: 「我把虹放在雲彩中，這就是我立約的記號。」

lines.en: "When I see the rainbow in the clouds, I will remember the eternal covenant between God and every living creature on earth."
lines.zh: 「虹必現在雲彩中，我看見，就要記念我與地上各樣有血肉的活物所立的永約。」

lessons.title: God's Promises for Abraham and Sarah
lessons.titleZh: 神給亞伯拉罕與撒拉的應許

lines.en: God's promises for Abraham and Sarah.
lines.zh: 神給亞伯拉罕與撒拉的應許。

lines.en: This is Abram, and he was married to Sarai.
lines.zh: 這是亞伯蘭，他娶了撒萊為妻。

lines.en: When they lived in Canaan, God told Abram he would give him all the land he could see, and that Abram would have as many children as there are stars in the sky.
lines.zh: 他們住在迦南時，神告訴亞伯蘭，凡他所看見的地都要賜給他，他的子孫也要多如天上的星。

lines.en: God said he would bless Abram's family, and they would be a blessing to all people.
lines.zh: 神說祂要賜福給亞伯蘭的家，他們也要叫萬民得福。

lines.en: Many years passed, and Abram and Sarai were very old and still had no children.
lines.zh: 過了許多年，亞伯蘭和撒萊年紀老邁，仍然沒有孩子。

lines.en: God appeared to Abram again and told him his name would now be Abraham, which means father of many nations.
lines.zh: 神再次向亞伯蘭顯現，告訴他從今以後要叫亞伯拉罕，意思是「多國之父」。

lines.en: God also changed Sarai's name to Sarah, and promised to bless Sarah with a son.
lines.zh: 神也把撒萊的名字改為撒拉，應許要賜福撒拉，使她生一個兒子。

lines.en: One day, Abraham was sitting at the entrance to his tent during the hottest part of the day.
lines.zh: 有一天，正午最熱的時候，亞伯拉罕坐在帳棚門口。

lines.en: When the Lord appeared to him, Abraham saw three men standing nearby, and he went to welcome them.
lines.zh: 耶和華向他顯現，亞伯拉罕看見有三個人站在附近，就上前迎接他們。

lines.en: He asked them to stay with him for a while to rest and eat.
lines.zh: 他請他們留下來休息一會兒，吃點東西。

lines.en: The men agreed.
lines.zh: 那三個人答應了。

lines.en: So Abraham had Sarah and his servant prepare food for the men.
lines.zh: 亞伯拉罕就叫撒拉和僕人為他們預備食物。

lines.en: When the food was ready, Abraham took the food and served it.
lines.zh: 食物預備好了，亞伯拉罕就端去招待他們。

lines.en: The men asked him, "Where is your wife, Sarah?"
lines.zh: 他們問他：「你妻子撒拉在哪裡？」

lines.en: Abraham said, "Over there in the tent."
lines.zh: 亞伯拉罕說：「在帳棚裡。」

lines.en: Then one of them said, "I will return to you about this time next year. Your wife Sarah will have a son."
lines.zh: 其中一位說：「明年這時候我必要回到你這裡，你的妻子撒拉必生一個兒子。」

lines.en: Sarah was listening to this from the tent.
lines.zh: 撒拉在帳棚裡聽見了這話。

lines.en: She laughed to herself, because she thought it was funny to think that she and Abraham could have a child in their old age.
lines.zh: 她心裡暗笑，覺得她和亞伯拉罕這麼老了還能生孩子，實在好笑。

lines.en: Then the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh? Is anything too hard for me?"
lines.zh: 耶和華對亞伯拉罕說：「撒拉為甚麼笑？耶和華豈有難成的事嗎？」

lines.en: Sarah was afraid, so she lied and said, "I didn't laugh."
lines.zh: 撒拉害怕，就說謊：「我沒有笑。」

lines.en: But the Lord said, "Yes, you laughed."
lines.zh: 耶和華說：「不然，你實在笑了。」

lines.en: A year later, Sarah did have a son.
lines.zh: 一年後，撒拉果然生了一個兒子。

lines.en: They named him Isaac.
lines.zh: 他們給他起名叫以撒。

lines.en: God's promises came true for Abraham and Sarah.
lines.zh: 神給亞伯拉罕和撒拉的應許都實現了。

lines.en: Abraham became the father of many nations.
lines.zh: 亞伯拉罕成了多國之父。

lines.en: And from his child came children, and from their children, more children, until Abraham's descendants were truly more than the stars in the sky, just as the Lord had promised.
lines.zh: 從他的孩子生出孩子，孩子又生孩子，直到亞伯拉罕的後裔真的比天上的星還多，正如耶和華所應許的。

lines.en: This is Jacob, who was later called Israel.
lines.zh: 這是雅各，他後來被稱為以色列。

lines.en: Jacob was the father of twelve sons, who became the twelve tribes of Israel.
lines.zh: 雅各有十二個兒子，他們成為以色列的十二支派。

lines.en: Jacob had a twin brother named Esau.
lines.zh: 雅各有個雙胞胎哥哥，名叫以掃。

lines.en: Even when Jacob and Esau were in their mother's belly, they fought.
lines.zh: 雅各和以掃還在母腹裡的時候，就彼此相爭。

lines.en: As the boys grew up, Esau liked to be outside and to hunt, while Jacob was quiet and liked to stay home.
lines.zh: 兩個孩子長大了，以掃喜歡在外面打獵，雅各則很安靜，喜歡待在家裡。

lines.en: Their father Isaac loved Esau because he liked eating what Esau hunted, but Rebekah, their mother, loved Jacob.
lines.zh: 父親以撒愛以掃，因為他喜歡吃以掃打來的野味；母親利百加卻愛雅各。

lines.en: Esau had a birthright, which means he would get special things and privileges because he was the firstborn.
lines.zh: 以掃有長子的名分，意思是他因為是頭生的，可以得到特別的東西和權利。

lines.en: One day, Jacob was making a stew, and Esau came home very hungry and asked for some.
lines.zh: 有一天，雅各在熬湯，以掃餓著肚子回家，向他要湯喝。

lines.en: Jacob said he would trade Esau some stew for his birthright.
lines.zh: 雅各說，要用湯換以掃長子的名分。

lines.en: Esau agreed, and Jacob was given Esau's birthright.
lines.zh: 以掃答應了，雅各就得了以掃長子的名分。

lines.en: Later on, Isaac, their father, was getting very old, and he wanted to bless his son Esau.
lines.zh: 後來，父親以撒年紀老邁，想要祝福兒子以掃。

lines.en: Isaac's blessing was very important, and Rebekah wanted Jacob to have the blessing instead of Esau.
lines.zh: 以撒的祝福非常重要，利百加想讓雅各、而不是以掃得到這個祝福。

lines.en: So Rebekah told Jacob to pretend to be Esau and go to his father for the blessing.
lines.zh: 利百加就叫雅各假扮成以掃，到父親那裡去領受祝福。

lines.en: Isaac was turning blind, so he believed that Jacob was Esau, and he blessed him.
lines.zh: 以撒眼睛昏花，以為雅各就是以掃，就給他祝福了。

lines.en: Esau came to his father to get his blessing, but Isaac had already given it to Jacob.
lines.zh: 以掃來向父親求祝福，但以撒已經把祝福給了雅各。

lines.en: All of this made Esau hate his brother Jacob.
lines.zh: 這一切使以掃恨他的弟弟雅各。

lines.en: Esau made plans to kill his brother.
lines.zh: 以掃打算殺掉他的弟弟。

lines.en: Rebekah heard of this and had Isaac send Jacob away to live with her family.
lines.zh: 利百加聽說了，就讓以撒打發雅各到她娘家去住。

lines.en: For many years Jacob lived with his uncle and worked in the field, taking care of his flock.
lines.zh: 雅各在舅舅那裡住了許多年，在田間工作，照顧羊群。

lines.en: He started a family and gained many servants, cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats.
lines.zh: 他成了家，又得了許多僕婢、牛、驢、綿羊和山羊。

lines.en: God told Jacob to leave his uncle's land and go back to the land of his father.
lines.zh: 神吩咐雅各離開舅舅的地，回到他父親之地去。

lines.en: So Jacob took his family and everything he owned and traveled back home.
lines.zh: 雅各就帶著家人和一切所有的，啟程回家。

lines.en: Jacob knew that his brother would be there, though.
lines.zh: 可是雅各知道哥哥會在那裡。

lines.en: So he sent messengers ahead and heard that Esau had an army of four hundred men with him.
lines.zh: 他就先打發使者去，聽說以掃帶著四百人的軍隊。

lines.en: Jacob prayed to God and asked him to rescue him from Esau.
lines.zh: 雅各向神禱告，求祂救他脫離以掃的手。

lines.en: Then he sent gifts ahead of him for his brother.
lines.zh: 他又先送禮物給哥哥。

lines.en: That night Jacob was alone in his camp, for he had sent his family and everything he had ahead of him.
lines.zh: 那夜雅各獨自留在營裡，因為他已經讓家人和所有的一切先過去了。

lines.en: But a man came and wrestled with him until dawn.
lines.zh: 有一個人來和他摔跤，直到黎明。

lines.en: The man saw that he wouldn't win, so he touched Jacob's hip and said, "Let me go."
lines.zh: 那人見自己勝不過他，就摸了雅各的大腿窩，說：「讓我走吧。」

lines.en: But Jacob said, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."
lines.zh: 雅各說：「你不給我祝福，我就不讓你走。」

lines.en: Then the man gave Jacob a new name.
lines.zh: 那人就給雅各一個新名字。

lines.en: He said, "From now on you will be called Israel, because you have fought with God and men and have won."
lines.zh: 他說：「從今以後你要叫以色列，因為你與神與人較力，都得了勝。」

lines.en: The man blessed Jacob.
lines.zh: 那人就給雅各祝福。

lines.en: Jacob left that place, but he had a limp because of the injury to his hip.
lines.zh: 雅各離開那裡，但因為大腿受了傷，走路一瘸一拐。

lines.en: Then Jacob looked up and saw his brother Esau coming with his four hundred men.
lines.zh: 雅各舉目一看，見哥哥以掃帶著四百人來了。

lines.en: Jacob went ahead of his family and bowed to his brother.
lines.zh: 雅各走在家人前面，向哥哥下拜。

lines.en: Esau ran to meet Jacob and hugged him. They both wept.
lines.zh: 以掃跑來迎接雅各，抱住他，兩人都哭了。

lines.en: Jacob introduced Esau to his family and gave him a gift, even though Esau said he had enough.
lines.zh: 雅各把家人介紹給以掃，又送他禮物，雖然以掃說他已經夠了。

lines.en: After everything Jacob and Esau had been through, the brothers made peace with each other.
lines.zh: 經歷了這一切之後，兄弟倆彼此和好了。

lines.en: And Jacob went on to be the father of the great nation of Israel.
lines.zh: 雅各後來成為以色列這個大國的祖先。

lines.en: This is Moses.
lines.zh: 這是摩西。

lines.en: Moses was the leader God chose to lead his chosen people, the Israelites, out of Egypt.
lines.zh: 摩西是神揀選的領袖，要帶領祂的選民以色列人出埃及。

lines.en: After God showed his miraculous power in Egypt, he led the Israelites through the Red Sea and towards the promised land.
lines.zh: 神在埃及彰顯祂奇妙的大能之後，就帶領以色列人過紅海，往應許之地去。

lines.en: They followed God, who showed himself as a cloud by day and a fire by night.
lines.zh: 他們跟隨神，神白天在雲柱中、夜間在火柱中向他們顯現。

lines.en: A few months after the Israelites left Egypt, they came to the desert of Sinai and camped there in front of the mountain.
lines.zh: 以色列人出埃及幾個月後，來到西奈的曠野，就在山前安營。

lines.en: God gave the Israelites a special set of rules called the Ten Commandments.
lines.zh: 神賜給以色列人一套特別的規條，稱為十誡。

lines.en: Moses climbed up to the mountain to hear from God, but the people were afraid.
lines.zh: 摩西爬上山去聽神的話，但百姓都很害怕。

lines.en: While the people remained a long way off, the Lord spoke to Moses and gave him many more commandments and instructions for the people of Israel to follow.
lines.zh: 百姓遠遠地站著，耶和華對摩西說話，又給他許多誡命和指示，要以色列人遵行。

lines.en: Then God wrote the commandments on two stone tablets and gave them to Moses.
lines.zh: 神把誡命寫在兩塊石版上，交給摩西。

lines.en: God told Moses that he must teach the people to obey the rules and do all that God had commanded.
lines.zh: 神告訴摩西，他必須教導百姓遵守這些規條，照神所吩咐的一切去行。

lines.en: When the Israelites followed God's commandments, they would show the world they lived differently than all the others and that they were God's chosen people.
lines.zh: 以色列人遵行神的誡命時，就會讓世人看見，他們的生活與眾不同，他們是神的選民。

lines.en: The people saw that Moses took a long time to come down from the mountain and they didn't know what happened to him.
lines.zh: 百姓見摩西遲遲不下山，不知道他遭遇了甚麼事。

lines.en: So they gathered around Aaron and asked him to make a god that could lead them.
lines.zh: 於是他們聚集到亞倫那裡，要他造一個能帶領他們的神。

lines.en: Aaron told them to give him their gold and he made it into a metal statue of a god that looked like a calf.
lines.zh: 亞倫叫他們把金子交給他，他把金子鑄成一尊像牛犢的神像。

lines.en: Then the people said, "Israel, here is your god who brought you up out of Egypt."
lines.zh: 百姓就說：「以色列啊，這是領你出埃及的神！」

lines.en: Aaron built an altar in front of the calf and declared the next day a feast day.
lines.zh: 亞倫在牛犢面前築壇，宣告明天要向耶和華守節。

lines.en: They sacrificed to the calf, celebrated, and danced wildly in front of their god.
lines.zh: 他們向牛犢獻祭、慶祝，在他們的神面前狂歡跳舞。

lines.en: The Lord spoke to Moses and told him to go down the mountain because of what the people were doing.
lines.zh: 耶和華對摩西說話，因百姓所做的事，吩咐他下山去。

lines.en: God told Moses that he would destroy the Israelites, but make a new nation out of Moses' family.
lines.zh: 神告訴摩西，祂要滅絕以色列人，卻要使摩西的家族成為大國。

lines.en: But Moses asked the Lord to have mercy on his people.
lines.zh: 但摩西求耶和華憐憫祂的百姓。

lines.en: Then the Lord took pity on his people.
lines.zh: 於是耶和華憐恤祂的百姓。

lines.en: He didn't destroy them as he said he would.
lines.zh: 祂沒有照所說的毀滅他們。

lines.en: Moses turned and went down the mountain.
lines.zh: 摩西轉身下山。

lines.en: He had two tablets that God had written in his hands.
lines.zh: 他手裡拿著神親手寫的兩塊法版。

lines.en: Joshua, Moses' assistant, heard the noise of the people shouting.
lines.zh: 摩西的助手約書亞聽見百姓呼喊的聲音。

lines.en: So he said to Moses, "It sounds like war in the camp."
lines.zh: 他就對摩西說：「營裡有爭戰的聲音。」

lines.en: But Moses said it was the sound of singing.
lines.zh: 摩西卻說，那是唱歌的聲音。

lines.en: As Moses approached the camp, he saw the calf and what the people were doing.
lines.zh: 摩西走近營地，看見牛犢，也看見百姓所做的事。

lines.en: So he was very angry.
lines.zh: 他就非常憤怒。

lines.en: He threw the tablets out of his hands and they broke into pieces at the foot of the mountain.
lines.zh: 他把兩塊法版從手裡扔下，在山腳下摔碎了。

lines.en: He took the calf the people had made.
lines.zh: 他把百姓所造的牛犢拿來，

lines.en: He burned it in the fire.
lines.zh: 用火焚燒，

lines.en: Then he ground it into powder.
lines.zh: 又磨得粉碎，

lines.en: He scattered it on the water and he made the Israelites drink it.
lines.zh: 撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。

lines.en: Moses asked Aaron why he would let the people do this.
lines.zh: 摩西問亞倫，為甚麼讓百姓這樣做。

lines.en: Aaron said it was the people's fault and that when he threw the gold into the fire, it came out as a calf.
lines.zh: 亞倫說這是百姓的錯，又說他把金子扔進火裡，這牛犢就出來了。

lines.en: Moses said, "Anyone on the Lord's side, come to me."
lines.zh: 摩西說：「凡屬耶和華的，都要到我這裡來！」

lines.en: All the Levites joined him.
lines.zh: 利未人都聚集到他那裡。

lines.en: Moses had the Levites punish the people for their sin.
lines.zh: 摩西叫利未人為百姓的罪懲罰他們。

lines.en: And the next day, Moses turned the people over to the Lord, but asked that he forgive their sin.
lines.zh: 第二天，摩西把百姓交在耶和華面前，求祂赦免他們的罪。

lines.en: The Lord sent a plague because of what the people did with the calf, but he didn't destroy the nation of Israel, even though they had turned away from him.
lines.zh: 耶和華因百姓造牛犢的事降下災殃，但祂沒有毀滅以色列，雖然他們背離了祂。

lines.en: Later, God had Moses make two new stone tablets, and God wrote on them the same words that were on the first tablets.
lines.zh: 後來，神叫摩西另鑿兩塊石版，神在上面寫了與先前那兩塊相同的字。

lines.en: God continued to speak with Moses and guide him as he led the Israelites.
lines.zh: 神繼續與摩西說話，在他帶領以色列人的路上引導他。

lines.en: This is Deborah.
lines.zh: 這是底波拉。

lines.en: Deborah was a judge of Israel and a prophet of God.
lines.zh: 底波拉是以色列的士師，也是神的先知。

lines.en: It was her job to lead the Israelites in the way God wanted, and to tell the people what God wanted her to say.
lines.zh: 她的職責是照神的心意帶領以色列人，並把神要她說的話告訴百姓。

lines.en: She would sit under a palm tree, and the Israelites would come up to her so she could help them make a decision when they didn't know what to do.
lines.zh: 她常坐在一棵棕樹下，以色列人不知道該怎麼辦時，就上她那裡去，請她幫忙做決定。

lines.en: There was a commander named Sisera, who was in charge of the army of Canaan, who were enemies of Israel.
lines.zh: 有一位將軍名叫西西拉，他統領迦南的軍隊，迦南人是以色列的仇敵。

lines.en: Sisera and his army treated the Israelites very badly for twenty years.
lines.zh: 西西拉和他的軍隊欺壓以色列人二十年。

lines.en: So the Israelites cried out to the Lord for help.
lines.zh: 以色列人就呼求耶和華幫助。

lines.en: Deborah sent for a man named Barak and said, "The Lord, the God of Israel, is giving you a command."
lines.zh: 底波拉派人叫一個名叫巴拉的人來，對他說：「耶和華以色列的神吩咐你。」

lines.en: "He says, 'Go, take ten thousand men from the tribes of Naphtali and Zebulun with you.'"
lines.zh: 「祂說：『你要從拿弗他利和西布倫支派中率領一萬人。』」

lines.en: "'Then lead them up to Mount Tabor.'"
lines.zh: 「『帶他們上他泊山。』」

lines.en: "'I will lead Sisera into a trap. There I will hand him over to you.'"
lines.zh: 「『我必使西西拉落入圈套，把他交在你手中。』」

lines.en: Barak said to her, "If you go with me, I'll go. But if you don't go with me, I won't go."
lines.zh: 巴拉對她說：「你若同我去，我就去；你若不同我去，我就不去。」

lines.en: "All right, I'll go with you."
lines.zh: 「好吧，我必與你同去。」

lines.en: "But because of the way you are doing this, you won't receive any honor."
lines.zh: 「只是你這樣做，就得不著榮耀。」

lines.en: "Instead, the Lord will hand Sisera over to a woman."
lines.zh: 「因為耶和華要把西西拉交在一個婦人手裡。」

lines.en: So Barak gathered the army God commanded, and Deborah also went with him.
lines.zh: 巴拉就照神的吩咐召集軍隊，底波拉也與他同去。

lines.en: Sisera gathered together his nine hundred chariots and all his men.
lines.zh: 西西拉召集了他的九百輛鐵車和全軍。

lines.en: Then Deborah said to Barak, "Go! Today the Lord will hand Sisera over to you. Hasn't the Lord gone ahead of you?"
lines.zh: 底波拉對巴拉說：「起來！今日就是耶和華把西西拉交在你手的日子。耶和華豈不在你前頭行嗎？」

lines.en: So Barak and his men marched out, and the Lord drove Sisera away from the battlefield.
lines.zh: 巴拉就帶著軍隊出征，耶和華使西西拉從戰場上潰逃。

lines.en: All of Sisera's army was defeated, but Sisera ran away on foot to the tent of a woman named Jael.
lines.zh: 西西拉的全軍都被打敗了，西西拉卻徒步逃到一個名叫雅億的婦人的帳棚。

lines.en: Jael brought Sisera into her tent.
lines.zh: 雅億把西西拉迎進帳棚。

lines.en: He thought she was helping him, but she quietly defeated him as he slept.
lines.zh: 他以為她在幫他，她卻趁他熟睡時悄悄打敗了他。

lines.en: Barak came and saw that what God told Deborah had happened, and Sisera had been defeated by a woman.
lines.zh: 巴拉趕到，看見神對底波拉說的話應驗了：西西拉被一個婦人打敗。

lines.en: On that day, God brought Canaan under Israel's control.
lines.zh: 那一日，神使迦南人被以色列人制伏。

lines.en: Deborah and Barak sang a song praising God for what he had done.
lines.zh: 底波拉和巴拉唱歌讚美神所做的事。

lines.en: And Israel was at peace again for forty years.
lines.zh: 以色列又太平了四十年。

lines.en: This is Daniel, who was a Jewish man who was taken to Babylon when he was very young.
lines.zh: 這是但以理，他是個猶太人，年紀很小就被擄到巴比倫。

lines.en: Daniel loved God and followed God's rules.
lines.zh: 但以理愛神，遵守神的律例。

lines.en: He talked to God three times a day and asked God for help often.
lines.zh: 他一天三次向神禱告，常常求神幫助。

lines.en: Daniel served in the Babylonian king's court for many years, and under many kings.
lines.zh: 但以理在巴比倫王的朝廷中事奉多年，歷經好幾位君王。

lines.en: Daniel always proved himself to be more capable than all the other court officials.
lines.zh: 但以理總是證明自己比朝中所有官員都更有才幹。

lines.en: Daniel was serving under King Darius, and because of his great abilities, the king made plans to place him in charge of the entire empire.
lines.zh: 但以理在大利烏王手下任職，因他才能出眾，王打算立他治理全國。

lines.en: The other court officials searched for some fault in Daniel, but they couldn't find anything wrong with him.
lines.zh: 其他官員想找但以理的把柄，卻找不到他有任何錯處。

lines.en: He was faithful, responsible, and completely trustworthy.
lines.zh: 他忠心、盡責，完全值得信賴。

lines.en: The court officials realized the only way to get at Daniel would be to challenge his faith.
lines.zh: 官員們意識到，要對付但以理，唯一的辦法就是從他的信仰下手。

lines.en: So they went to King Darius and advised him to make a law that for the next thirty days, any person who prays to anyone except King Darius will be thrown into the lions' den.
lines.zh: 於是他們去見大利烏王，建議他立一條法令：三十天內，凡向大利烏王以外的任何對象祈求的，必被扔進獅子坑。

lines.en: King Darius signed this law, and once a Babylonian king signed a law, it could not be overruled.
lines.zh: 大利烏王簽署了這條法令；巴比倫王一旦簽了法令，就不能更改。

lines.en: When Daniel learned of this law, he went home and knelt down as he always did to pray in his room, with the windows open towards Jerusalem.
lines.zh: 但以理知道了這條法令，就回到家裡，照常在房間裡跪下禱告，窗戶開向耶路撒冷。

lines.en: He prayed three times a day, just as he always had done, giving thanks to God and asking for his help.
lines.zh: 他一日三次禱告，跟往常一樣，感謝神，也求神幫助。

lines.en: The officials went to Daniel's house and found him praying.
lines.zh: 官員們到但以理家，發現他正在禱告。

lines.en: They went to the king and reminded him of the law.
lines.zh: 他們去見王，提醒他那條法令。

lines.en: Then they said that Daniel had been found praying to God three times a day.
lines.zh: 接著他們說，但以理被人看見一天三次向神禱告。

lines.en: When the king heard this, he was very upset.
lines.zh: 王聽了這話，非常難過。

lines.en: And he spent the whole day trying to think of a way to save Daniel.
lines.zh: 他花了一整天想辦法要救但以理。

lines.en: By that evening, the court officials came back to the king and reminded him that no law signed by the Babylonian king could be overruled.
lines.zh: 到了傍晚，官員們又來見王，提醒他巴比倫王所簽的法令都不能更改。

lines.en: So at last the king gave orders for Daniel to be thrown into the lions' den.
lines.zh: 王終於下令，把但以理扔進獅子坑。

lines.en: The king said to him, "May your God, whom you serve faithfully, rescue you."
lines.zh: 王對他說：「你所常事奉的神，必救你！」

lines.en: Then the lions' den was sealed shut with Daniel inside.
lines.zh: 然後獅子坑被封住，但以理在裡面。

lines.en: The king spent the night fasting and couldn't sleep.
lines.zh: 王整夜禁食，無法入睡。

lines.en: Then very early in the morning, the king hurried to the lions' den.
lines.zh: 次日清早，王急忙往獅子坑去。

lines.en: He called out, "Daniel, was your God able to rescue you from the lions?"
lines.zh: 他喊道：「但以理啊，你的神能救你脫離獅子嗎？」

lines.en: And Daniel answered, "Long live the king!"
lines.zh: 但以理回答：「願王萬歲！」

lines.en: "My God sent his angel to shut the lions' mouths so that they would not hurt me, for I have been found innocent in his sight."
lines.zh: 「我的神差遣使者封住獅子的口，叫獅子不傷我，因我在神面前無辜。」

lines.en: The king was overjoyed and ordered that Daniel be taken out of the lions' den.
lines.zh: 王非常歡喜，吩咐人把但以理從坑裡拉上來。

lines.en: Then the king ordered the men who had schemed against Daniel to be thrown into the lions' den as punishment.
lines.zh: 王又下令，把那些設計陷害但以理的人扔進獅子坑作為懲罰。

lines.en: Daniel was safe. There was not a scratch on him, for he trusted in God.
lines.zh: 但以理平安無事，身上毫無傷損，因為他信靠神。

lines.en: This is Nehemiah, who was a Jewish man who worked for a Persian king, Artaxerxes, the king of Babylon.
lines.zh: 這是尼希米，他是猶太人，在波斯王亞達薛西手下做事，那王也統治巴比倫。

lines.en: Many of the Jews had been sent to Babylon years before because they had disobeyed God.
lines.zh: 多年前，許多猶太人因為違背神，被擄到巴比倫。

lines.en: One day Nehemiah heard a report that the Jews who had returned to Judah were having a hard time, and that the walls of Jerusalem were broken down and the gates had been burned.
lines.zh: 有一天，尼希米聽到消息：回到猶大的猶太人處境艱難，耶路撒冷的城牆被拆毀，城門也被火焚燒。

lines.en: This made Nehemiah sad.
lines.zh: 這讓尼希米非常憂傷。

lines.en: He didn't eat any food for days and prayed to God for the Jews.
lines.zh: 他好幾天不吃東西，為猶太人向神禱告。

lines.en: He told God he was sorry for the wrong things he and his people had done.
lines.zh: 他向神認罪，為自己和同胞所犯的錯懺悔。

lines.en: He reminded God of his promises, and that God had said, "If you obey my commands, I will gather you together again."
lines.zh: 他求神記念祂的應許，神曾說：「你們若遵守我的誡命，我必再招聚你們。」

lines.en: Nehemiah asked for God to give him success as he went to ask the king for help.
lines.zh: 尼希米求神在他去求王幫助時，使他順利。

lines.en: Nehemiah went to do his job for the king.
lines.zh: 尼希米照常去服事王。

lines.en: The king asked why Nehemiah was sad.
lines.zh: 王問尼希米為甚麼面帶愁容。

lines.en: So Nehemiah told the king about his people in Judah.
lines.zh: 尼希米就把猶大同胞的事告訴王。

lines.en: Nehemiah prayed and told the king he wanted to rebuild the city of Jerusalem.
lines.zh: 尼希米默默禱告，然後告訴王，他想重建耶路撒冷城。

lines.en: He asked for letters from the king that would help him travel safely to Jerusalem and get the supplies he needed to rebuild the city.
lines.zh: 他求王賜下詔書，讓他平安抵達耶路撒冷，並取得重建城所需的材料。

lines.en: God helped Nehemiah, and the king gave Nehemiah all he asked for.
lines.zh: 神幫助尼希米，王就把他所求的都賜給他。

lines.en: Nehemiah went to Jerusalem and checked out the walls.
lines.zh: 尼希米到了耶路撒冷，察看城牆。

lines.en: He went to the people and said, "Come on, let's rebuild the wall of Jerusalem."
lines.zh: 他到百姓那裡說：「來吧，我們來重建耶路撒冷的城牆！」

lines.en: And the people agreed and started that good work.
lines.zh: 百姓都同意，就開始做這美好的工作。

lines.en: Meanwhile, there were some officials from nearby lands who heard Nehemiah was rebuilding the wall and were upset.
lines.zh: 這時，鄰近地方的一些官員聽說尼希米在重建城牆，就很不高興。

lines.en: They laughed at the Jews and made fun of them.
lines.zh: 他們嗤笑猶太人，嘲弄他們。

lines.en: But Nehemiah said, "The God of heaven will give us success. We serve him."
lines.zh: 尼希米卻說：「天上的神必使我們亨通，我們是事奉祂的。」

lines.en: Many Jews worked together to rebuild the wall, including the priests, men who worked with gold, a man who made perfume, leaders from nearby villages, servants, guards, traders, and daughters as well.
lines.zh: 許多猶太人同心重建城牆，包括祭司、金匠、做香料的、鄰近村莊的首領、僕人、守衛、商人，還有女兒們。

lines.en: All the people worked with all their hearts.
lines.zh: 百姓都全心全意地做工。

lines.en: The officials from other lands planned to fight the Jews, but the Jews prayed to God and put guards on duty day and night.
lines.zh: 外地的官員計劃攻擊猶太人，但猶太人向神禱告，並安排守衛晝夜看守。

lines.en: Nehemiah stationed people to defend the city where it was weak.
lines.zh: 尼希米在城牆薄弱的地方派人防守。

lines.en: From that day on, half of the people did the work with swords at their sides, and the other half were armed to defend the people working and the city.
lines.zh: 從那天起，一半的人腰間佩刀做工，另一半的人拿著兵器，保護做工的人和整座城。

lines.en: Nehemiah reminded them, "Our God will fight for us."
lines.zh: 尼希米提醒他們：「我們的神必為我們爭戰！」

lines.en: They worked from sunrise until the stars came out.
lines.zh: 他們從日出一直做到星宿出現。

lines.en: After fifty-two days, the city wall was finally finished.
lines.zh: 五十二天後，城牆終於完工了。

lines.en: All of Judah's enemies were afraid, because they realized that God helped the people finish the work.
lines.zh: 猶大所有的仇敵都懼怕了，因為他們知道這工作是神幫助百姓完成的。

lines.en: Jerusalem was large. It had a lot of room, but only a few people lived there.
lines.zh: 耶路撒冷城很大，有許多空間，住的人卻很少。

lines.en: So God gave Nehemiah the idea to gather more people to come and live in Jerusalem, now that the wall had been rebuilt.
lines.zh: 於是神感動尼希米：既然城牆已經重建，就招聚更多人來住在耶路撒冷。

lines.en: And many people returned home to Israel as God gathered his people together again.
lines.zh: 許多人回到故土，神再次招聚了祂的子民。

lines.en: A teacher of God's law named Ezra came and read the Book of the Law to all the people who could understand.
lines.zh: 一位名叫以斯拉的律法教師，向所有能聽明白的百姓宣讀律法書。

lines.en: Then they worshiped God and promised to follow God's commands.
lines.zh: 於是他們敬拜神，並承諾要遵行神的誡命。

lines.en: These are the apostles. They followed Jesus during his time on earth.
lines.zh: 這些是使徒，耶穌在世的時候，他們一直跟隨祂。

lines.en: Before Jesus went to heaven, he told them to stay in Jerusalem until God sent the gift he promised.
lines.zh: 耶穌升天以前，吩咐他們留在耶路撒冷，等候神所應許的恩賜。

lines.en: So after Jesus went to heaven, the apostles stayed in Jerusalem along with the other people who believed in Jesus.
lines.zh: 所以耶穌升天以後，使徒們和其他信耶穌的人一起留在耶路撒冷。

lines.en: One day they were all gathered together when there was a sound from heaven like a mighty windstorm.
lines.zh: 有一天，他們都聚集在一起，忽然從天上有響聲，好像一陣大風。

lines.en: Then what looked like flames appeared and settled on each of them, and everyone was filled with the Holy Spirit.
lines.zh: 接著有像火焰的舌頭顯現，分開落在他們各人頭上，他們就都被聖靈充滿。

lines.en: The Holy Spirit gave them the ability to speak in other languages, and so they started speaking.
lines.zh: 聖靈賜給他們說別國語言的能力，他們就開始說起來。

lines.en: At that time, there were devout Jews from every nation living in Jerusalem.
lines.zh: 那時，有從各國來的虔誠猶太人住在耶路撒冷。

lines.en: When they heard the loud noise, they came running to see what it was.
lines.zh: 他們聽見這巨大的聲響，就跑來看是怎麼回事。

lines.en: When they saw the believers speaking in their own languages, they were shocked and amazed.
lines.zh: 他們聽見信徒說著自己家鄉的語言，都驚訝萬分。

lines.en: They wondered, "How can this be? These people are from Galilee, and yet we hear them speaking in our own native languages about the wonderful things God has done!"
lines.zh: 他們心想：「這是怎麼回事？這些人都是加利利人，我們怎麼聽見他們用我們的鄉談，講說神的大作為呢？」

lines.en: "What can this mean?"
lines.zh: 「這是甚麼意思呢？」

lines.en: But others in the crowd didn't believe that it was really a miracle, and thought the believers were just acting oddly.
lines.zh: 但人群中也有人不相信這是神蹟，以為信徒們只是舉止怪異。

lines.en: Then Peter stepped forward and shouted to the crowd, "Listen carefully, all of you!"
lines.zh: 彼得就站出來，向眾人高聲說：「你們都要留心聽！」

lines.en: He told them that they were not acting strangely, but that this was from God.
lines.zh: 他告訴他們，這些人不是行為怪異，這是從神來的。

lines.en: He reminded them that God said this would happen long ago.
lines.zh: 他提醒他們，神很久以前就說過這事要發生。

lines.en: Then Peter told them about how Jesus was crucified, but then raised to life again, just as God had said he would be.
lines.zh: 接著彼得告訴他們，耶穌怎樣被釘十字架，又照神所說的復活了。

lines.en: He told them that Jesus was now in heaven, and that God had given the Holy Spirit to them as he had promised.
lines.zh: 他告訴他們，耶穌現在在天上，神也照祂所應許的，把聖靈賜給了他們。

lines.en: Peter's words changed what the people thought and felt, and they asked, "Brothers, what should we do?"
lines.zh: 彼得的話改變了眾人的想法和感受，他們就問：「弟兄們，我們當怎樣行？」

lines.en: Peter told them, "Each of you must repent of your sins and turn to God, and be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins."
lines.zh: 彼得說：「你們各人要悔改，歸向神，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦。」

lines.en: "Then you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit."
lines.zh: 「就必領受所賜的聖靈。」

lines.en: Peter continued to preach to the crowd for a long time, and those who believed what Peter said were baptized.
lines.zh: 彼得繼續向群眾講了很久，凡相信他話的人都受了洗。

lines.en: Three thousand people were baptized and added to the church that day.
lines.zh: 那天受洗加入教會的約有三千人。

lines.en: Then all the believers listened to the apostles' teaching and practiced what they taught.
lines.zh: 所有信徒都聽從使徒的教導，並且實踐出來。

lines.en: They met together in fellowship, shared meals, and prayed together.
lines.zh: 他們彼此交接、一起用餐、一同禱告。

lines.en: They were amazed as the apostles performed many miraculous signs and wonders.
lines.zh: 使徒們行了許多神蹟奇事，眾人都很驚奇。

lines.en: All the believers met together in one place and shared everything they had.
lines.zh: 信的人都聚在一處，凡物公用。

lines.en: They helped those in need, worshiped together at the temple every day, met in homes for the Lord's Supper, and shared their meals with great joy.
lines.zh: 他們幫助有需要的人，天天同心在聖殿敬拜，在家中擘餅記念主，歡歡喜喜地一同吃飯。

lines.en: All while praising God and enjoying each other.
lines.zh: 他們讚美神，也彼此享受相處的時光。

lines.en: And each day God added to their fellowship those who were being saved.
lines.zh: 主將得救的人天天加給他們。
